summary:
Agricultural Decisions
AgroSight is an interactive web-based platform designed to support farmers in making informed agricultural decisions by transforming environmental and climate data into accessible, location-based insights. Agriculture is increasingly affected by climate change, unpredictable rainfall, declining water availability, soil moisture variations, and extreme temperatures. However, accessing and interpreting environmental data can be challenging, particularly for farmers without technical or scientific expertise.
Our platform addresses this challenge through an interactive map that allows users to select geographical areas and explore available environmental indicators. By integrating Earth observation data, including NASA's Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP) mission data, alongside other relevant environmental data sources, AgroSight helps users understand local conditions and explore environmental patterns that may influence agricultural activities.
The platform aims to make complex scientific information easier to understand and more useful for practical agricultural planning. It is designed to serve farmers, agricultural advisors ,and communities by providing a clearer picture of environmental conditions and supporting decisions related to water management and crop planning.
Our vision is to bridge the gap between satellite data and everyday agricultural needs, contributing to more informed, resilient, and sustainable farming practices.
details: 1. Project Function AgroSight is an interactive web-based platform designed to help farmers and agricultural communities better understand environmental conditions that affect agriculture. It transforms environmental and climate information into accessible, location-based insights, helping users explore factors such as soil moisture, water availability, and climate conditions that may influence agricultural activities. 2. How It Works Users interact with a digital map to select or explore a geographical area. The platform then provides access to available environmental information associated with the selected location. Through the map and its interface, users can explore environmental indicators, understand local conditions, and identify patterns that may be relevant to agricultural planning. The platform aims to make Earth observation information easier to explore and understand, especially for users without technical or scientific backgrounds. 3. Expected Impact AgroSight aims to: - Make environmental information more accessible to farmers. - Support more informed agricultural planning. - Improve awareness of soil moisture and water-related conditions. - Encourage better water-resource management. - Contribute to more resilient and sustainable agricultural practices. The project is intended to support decision-making, not replace farmers' experience or professional agricultural advice. 4. Tools, Programming Languages, and Technologies The project was developed as a web application using: - HTML: to structure the website. - CSS: to design the interface and its layout. - JavaScript: to implement interactive features. - Leaflet.js: to create the interactive geographical map. - GitHub Pages: to publish and host the website. AI-assisted tools were also used during development to support code generation, debugging, and preparation of project documentation. 5. Creativity and Innovation The creative aspect of AgroSight lies in connecting Earth observation information with practical agricultural needs through a simple, interactive, location-based platform. Instead of requiring users to interpret complex scientific datasets independently, the project provides a more accessible way to explore environmental conditions through a map-based interface. It focuses on making scientific information understandable and useful for people who may not have a background in remote sensing or data analysis. 6. Factors Considered by the Team During development, the team considered: - Accessibility: making the platform understandable for users with different levels of technical knowledge. - Usability: keeping the interface simple and easy to navigate. - Geographical flexibility: designing the platform to explore different locations rather than limiting it to one specific region. - Environmental relevance: focusing on conditions that can influence agricultural activities. - Data availability and reliability: considering the availability and limitations of environmental data. - Local knowledge: recognizing the importance of farmers' experience and local agricultural conditions. Conclusion AgroSight aims to bridge the gap between satellite-based environmental information and everyday agricultural needs. By making Earth observation information easier to explore, the project seeks to support informed decisions and contribute to a more sustainable and climate-resilient agricultural future.
